name: Craftsman's Writ - Runecloth Robe
label: Quest
description: Craftsman's Writ - Runecloth Robe: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.
All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You shouldn't have! No really, you shouldn't have. I don't know what Metz is thinking, but nobody is going to be wearing these robes into Naxxramas.
Bah, another pile of junk I'll have to get transferred to the front lines and another berating I'll have to take from Chambers.
